home.title: Buba Tea — the first healthy bubble tea in Bali
home.description: No syrup bases, no preservatives. Tea shots pulled to order, purées made fresh each morning, ceremonial matcha from Japan. Bubble tea and matcha in Bali.

hero.h1: The first healthy bubble tea and matcha in Bali
hero.lead: No syrup bases, no powders, no preservatives, and nothing standing in a dispenser for hours. Every tea shot is pulled to order, the fruit purées are made fresh each morning, and even the ice is our own.

usp.title: What you are actually paying for

items.title: Tea pulled like espresso
items.text: Most places brew tea in batches, and it sits losing flavour for hours. We extract every shot to order on a teapresso machine — the same idea as coffee, applied to tea.

items.title: Leaves from China, matcha from Japan
items.text: We went and found them ourselves. Dozens of lots tasted in China before we picked the leaf, and a trip to Japan for ceremonial-grade matcha with the smoothest flavour.

items.title: Coffee we build with the farm
items.text: Our beans come from a Bali farm we work with directly. We visit it, choose the beans, and had a roasting profile developed for Buba Tea alone.

items.title: Purées made this morning
items.text: Every fruit purée is ours, made from fresh fruit with no preservatives. We prepare them each morning, so what you taste is fruit and not syrup.

items.title: Even the ice is ours
items.text: Ice changes a cold drink more than people expect. We freeze our own from distilled water, fresh daily, so nothing muddies the taste as it melts.

items.title: Less waste, more care
items.text: Reusable cups, and insulated bags that keep delivery orders properly cold on the way to you.

community.title: More than drinks
community.text: We regularly support charitable initiatives and help children in need in our community.

closing.title: You're not just paying for tea — you're paying for the difference.

signature.title: Our drinks
signature.lead: Tap a category. Everything here is made to order — the tea shot pulled, the matcha whisked, the purée spooned in fresh.

items.a: GoFood and GrabFood give you a live estimate when you place the order — it depends on where you are and how the traffic is running.

items.q: Is it the same menu as in the cafe?
items.a: Yes. Both apps carry the full menu, and the drinks are made exactly the same way.

items.q: Will it still be cold when it arrives?
items.a: That is what the insulated bags and our own ice are for. Cold drinks are sealed and packed to hold their temperature for the ride.

items.q: Can I order something that is not in the app?
items.a: Message us on WhatsApp — large orders and custom requests are easier to sort out directly, and we answer questions there too. The delivery itself still goes through GoFood or GrabFood.

packing.title: It arrives the way it left
packing.lead: Delivered bubble tea usually disappoints for one of two reasons: it went warm, or the ice watered it down. We deal with both.

items.title: Insulated bags
items.text: Orders go out in insulated bags rather than paper ones, so a long ride does not turn a cold drink into a lukewarm one.

items.title: Ice that melts clean
items.text: We freeze our own ice from distilled water every day. It melts without taste, so the bottom of the cup is not weaker than the top.

items.title: Made when you order
items.text: Nothing is poured in advance. The tea shot is pulled and the drink built after your order comes in, not before.

privacy.title: Privacy policy — Buba Tea
privacy.description: How Buba Tea collects and uses data on this website.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.text: This website is run by {legalName}, based in Bali, Indonesia. You can reach us at {email}.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.text: The website itself does not ask you to create an account. When you use the catering form, the details you enter are put into a WhatsApp message that you choose to send — we only receive them once you press send in WhatsApp. We also collect anonymous usage data (pages viewed, approximate region, device type, how you arrived) through Google Analytics and Google Ads.

sections.title: Cookies and similar tools
sections.text: We use cookies for two things: measuring how the site is used, and measuring which ads bring people to us. You can accept or decline these when you first visit, and change your mind at any time using the link in the footer. Declining does not limit anything on the site.

sections.title: Advertising
sections.text: We advertise through Google Ads. If you agree to advertising cookies, Google may show you our ads on other sites and tell us, in aggregate, how the campaign performed. We never receive your name or contact details this way.

sections.title: How long we keep things
sections.text: Analytics data is kept for up to 14 months. WhatsApp conversations about catering are kept while we are arranging your event and for our accounting records afterwards.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.text: You can ask us what we hold about you, ask us to delete it, or withdraw your consent to cookies. Write to {email} and we will reply within 30 days.

sections.title: Changes
sections.text: If we change this policy we will update the date at the top of this page.

terms.title: Terms of use — Buba Tea
terms.description: Terms for using the Buba Tea website.

sections.title: About these terms
sections.text: This website is provided by {legalName} to show our menu, opening hours and services. By using it, you accept what is written here.

sections.title: Menu and prices
sections.text: The menu is synced from our till, so it reflects what we serve today. Even so, items can sell out and prices can change without notice. The price at the counter or in the delivery app is the one that applies.

sections.title: Orders and delivery
sections.text: Delivery orders placed through GoFood or GrabFood are governed by those services' own terms. Orders arranged over WhatsApp are confirmed once we reply and agree the details with you.

sections.title: Catering bookings
sections.text: A catering request is not a booking. A date is held once we have sent you a quote, you have accepted it, and the deposit has been paid. Cancellation terms are set out in the quote.

sections.title: Content on this site
sections.text: The Buba Tea name, logo, photographs and text belong to us. Please do not reuse them commercially without asking.

sections.title: Links to other sites
sections.text: We link to GoFood, GrabFood, Google Maps and social networks. We are not responsible for what happens on those sites.

sections.title: Getting in touch
sections.text: Questions about these terms go to {email}.
